payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear definition and explanation of a second order co-occurrence matrix, detailing its construction and application in measuring semantic relatedness.

claims.text: A second order co-occurrence matrix is constructed from a first-order co-occurrence matrix and incorporates semantic similarity scores to measure relatedness between concepts.
The second order co-occurrence vector is created by averaging first-order co-occurrence vectors associated with terms, which helps in representing the meaning of the terms.
Integrating semantic similarity into second order co-occurrence matrices improves correlation with human judgments for similarity and relatedness.
